debrief.title: Attending debrief
debrief.subtitle: How you ran the case: the process behind the diagnosis.

verdict.correctBody: You committed the right diagnosis. Now check the process that got you there.
verdict.nearMissBody: A reasonable diagnosis, but not the leading one for this presentation. Review the evidence you weighed.
verdict.incorrectBody: This diagnosis does not fit the evidence gathered. Work back through the process below.

redFlags.heading: Red-flag danger signs
redFlags.none: No red-flag danger signs defined for this case.

workup.heading: Work-up appropriateness
workup.clean: Appropriate work-up: no key tests missed and nothing over-ordered.

teaching.heading: Teaching points
teaching.safety: Close the safety-critical gap: check allergies and order the mandatory test before management.
teaching.redFlags: You missed {{count}} red-flag danger sign(s). Screen for danger signs before narrowing the differential.
teaching.workupGap: A key test was not ordered ({{label}}). Order it early for this presentation.
teaching.dxIncorrect: Widen the differential and order the key rule-out test before committing.
teaching.dxNear: You were close. Re-weigh the leading differential against the evidence you gathered.
teaching.overOrder: Avoid low-value tests that do not change management; order to a question, not by reflex.
teaching.coverage: Broaden the history: several expected lines of questioning were not covered.
teaching.clean: Well-run encounter: safe, focused, and committed on the evidence.
